messages:
ravi (CS): Quick sync: Orbiton cutover moved to Wed 08:30 PT. Need final thumbs on quota windows, burst headroom, and an abbreviated load smoke. Who's on watch?

sophia (EngProxy): I'll be on the control plane side. Request: can we limit simultaneous long-context jobs to 8 during the first 2h? That helped in previous cutovers.

tim (SRE): Good call. Proposed plan:
- prewarm KV cache 6m with prefix-heavy pings
- staged traffic: 10% (5m) -> 35% (10m) -> 70% (20m) -> steady at target
- enable temporary headroom: +1.8x for 4m if queue_ms spike detected
- rollback if error_rate>4% for 8m or p95>2500ms for 10m

jordan (Solutions): Orbiton's SRE wants the smoke at 08:55 PT (post-soak). They'll run a short batch import at +90m; ask them to notify 10m prior. Also they asked for the embeddings route to have a dedicated temp quota during the first hour.

ravi (CS): Can we add a per-route throttle for embeddings for the first 60m? And surface a simple dashboard link for Orbiton ops. Also need the exact autoscale policy to paste into the customer runbook.

ci-bot: CI pipeline ID 8742 succeeded. Deployment window reserved: 2026-03-25 08:30 PT.

tim (SRE): Autoscale snippet (pasted to ticket):

```
{"scale":{"up_when":"cpu_95>0.92 or queue_ms>1800","down_when":"cpu_5<0.55","scale_up_cooldown":"2m","scale_down_cooldown":"12m","burst_headroom":{"factor":"1.8","duration":"4m","trigger_window":"first_120m"},"limits":{"max_instances":"200","min_instances":"6"}}
```

sophia (EngProxy): Embeddings throttle: route-embeddings temporary quota = 120 rps for first 60m, then auto-unlock. I'll set a soft limit and make it visible in the console.

ravi (CS): Thanks. Jordan, can you coordinate the +90m batch import notification with Orbiton? Also pls confirm who calls rollback.

jordan (Solutions): I'll be on the call. We agreed Orbiton's on-call will pause/import only after our green signal. Our rollback authority: tim (SRE) + sophia (EngProxy) can flip fallback model if needed.

tim (SRE): Fallback model staged: v1.2-stable-fp16. We'll keep control-plane toggle available and a one-click rollback doc in CS-4901.

ravi (CS): Final checklist for EOD prep: 1) tim paste autoscale + rollback into CS-4901, 2) sophia set embeddings soft quota + dashboard link, 3) jordan confirm +90m import notice in ticket, 4) I'll send customer-facing timeline and runbook.

jordan (Solutions): Done on my part, added note to CS-4901: Orbiton will notify 10m before batch.

sophia (EngProxy): Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.dev/dash/route-latency?team=orbiton (shared)

ci-bot: Reminder scheduled: Orbiton cutover preflight at 07:45 PT.

ravi (CS): Great work team. I'll lock the window and ping Orbiton tonight with the runbook. :pray:

sophia (EngProxy): One more: limit long-context concurrency enforced via proxy config. I pushed config change to canary; will promote at 08:15 PT if metrics look good.

tim (SRE): Canary looks nominal. Promoting at 08:15 PT unless anyone objects.

ravi (CS): No objections. Closing prep. Will update ticket CS-4901 when customer ack received. :white_check_mark:
